site.audience: commercial real estate investors, occupiers, property owners, and corporate clients

brief.title: GlobalStone — Global Commercial Real Estate Services
brief.one_liner: GlobalStone is the global leader in commercial real estate services and investments, providing integrated, data-led solutions across every dimension of real estate.
brief.goal: Establish authority as the premier commercial real estate services firm, showcase the breadth of service offerings, and drive engagement with potential clients across investment, leasing, design, and property management needs.

pages.objective: Serve as the main landing page that communicates the company's global leadership, showcases key services, highlights latest insights and research, and provides pathways to explore services and careers.
Present an overview of all commercial real estate service categories with brief descriptions and links to explore each service area in detail.
Detail the investment, finance, and valuation services including capabilities like capital markets, valuation, forecasting, and sustainability solutions, with social proof and related content.
Showcase planning, leasing, and occupancy services including transaction services, site selection, workplace solutions, lease administration, portfolio strategy, and consulting capabilities.
Present design and build services including project management and supply chain sourcing capabilities, along with a strategic partnership highlight.
